notes.title: Clean Sweep Demo Update!
notes.content: [h1]Clean Sweep Demo Update is Live![/h1][p][/p][p]Hey Sweepy Heads![/p][p][/p][p]We've been working hard to bring you new features and content for the Clean Sweep Demo! Here's a list of everything we've added![/p][list][*][p]Leveling System[/p][/*][*][p]Main Story Level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Soap's First Event[/p][/*][*][p]Environment Interactions[/p][/*][*][p]New Music[/p][/*][*][p]A New Quest[/p][/*][*][p]New Dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]A Ton of Bug Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who's played the game so far! We could not have done this without you. We hope that you enjoy the current and future Clean Sweep content![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]There is a [b]known bug[/b] where after completing the first level of the Main Story, you can't exit the Dining Room. If you find yourself unable to exit after Beau gives the okay to leave, use the home button on your cellphone to return to the entrance of the mansion and continue with your day. [/p][p]We're working hard to fix this and any other bugs you may encounter![/p][p][/p][p]Make sure to join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FpHH8Rtemxu"]Discord[/url] and follow us on our socials![/p]
